A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Vigo''' of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate was once eliminated after trying to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], organizational [[Underlord]], in a personal bid for power. Xizor then elevated the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Vekker (Quarren)|Vekker]], an unremarkable and unambitious Black Sun servant, to fill the vacated [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] position.
